brief: A CNA shift report documenting patient behavior, vital sign changes, and clinical observations for the charge nurse at a skilled nursing facility.

# CNA Shift Observation and Incident Handoff Report
Unit: West Wing Subacute Care | Date: 10/14/2026 | Shift: 0700-1530
Reporting CNA: Marcus Reyes, CNA | Charge Nurse: Brenda Vance, RN

## Resident Summary
| Room | Resident Name | MRN | Fall Risk | Diet Order |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 214-B | Harold Jenkins | 492018 | High | Pureed, Honey-Thick Liquids |
| 218-A | Clara Higgins | 381044 | Moderate | Regular, Thin Liquids |

## Observations and Care Log
- 0815: Room 218-A assisted with morning ADLs. Resident alert and oriented x4. Ambulates with rolling walker 50 ft in corridor with standby assist. Skin intact, sacrum clear.
- 0900: Room 214-B breakfast intake recorded. Resident consumed 25% of pureed eggs and 4 oz apple juice. Observed coughing spells after each swallow. Bed elevated to 45 degrees during intake.
- 1130: Room 214-B vital signs check: Temp 99.1°F, BP 138/82 mmHg, HR 88 bpm, RR 22 breaths/min, SpO2 91% on room air. Resident complained of feeling congested and fatigued.
- 1145: Room 214-B observed in bed with mild inspiratory wheezing. Resident appeared comfortable with no signs of airway compromise or dysphagia during meal.
- 1230: Room 218-A lunch meal. Resident consumed 90% of turkey sandwich, 100% applesauce, and 8 oz water. No chewing difficulties noted.
- 1315: Room 218-A voiced complaint of sharp pain in left lower flank during toileting transfer, rating pain 7/10. Notified nurse Brenda Vance, RN.
- 1400: Room 214-B post-lunch repositioning. Skin assessment noted new non-blanchable erythema on left ischium.
- 1445: Verbal handoff given to Brenda Vance, RN.

errors.quote: Resident appeared comfortable with no signs of airway compromise or dysphagia during meal.
errors.explanation: This statement contradicts the 0900 entry, which specifically documented coughing spells after each swallow, an elevated respiratory rate, reduced SpO2 (91%), and a diet requiring honey-thick liquids due to dysphagia.
errors.fix: Resident displayed persistent productive cough and mild respiratory distress following meal.

errors.quote: Skin assessment noted new non-blanchable erythema on left ischium.
errors.explanation: When documenting a new localized skin alteration such as Stage 1 pressure injury/non-blanchable erythema, the CNA must record the immediate nurse notification and the measurements or approximate size of the affected area.
errors.fix: Skin assessment noted new non-blanchable erythema on left ischium measuring approximately 2 cm x 2 cm; notified Brenda Vance, RN immediately.
